correctness.rationale: Record-count decrements are independent sums of Bernoulli(1/j). The exact potential identity D_n-A_n= - sum (R_m-H_m)/H_m - U_n has nonnegative drift debt with expectation O(log n) because a descending state can be visited at most once and the one-step debt is O(1/m) in expectation. The rescaled predictable quadratic variation converges to 1 by separating states above epsilon*n, an intermediate interval, and states below n^(1/3). Fourth moment bounds prove conditional Lindeberg. Martingale CLT yields Gaussian fluctuations of scale sqrt(n)/log n. Euler--Maclaurin/integral comparison gives harmonic-center asymptotics. The standalone standard-library checker passed 146 exact-rational/permutation checks up to m=13; these checks do not assert the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The source explicitly defines a natural resampling variant but leaves its fluctuation scale unresolved. The Gaussian standard deviation sqrt(n)/log n contrasts sharply with Tracy--Widom fluctuations in the non-resampling problem. A deterministic harmonic potential center differs from the exact expectation by O(log n), which is negligible relative to fluctuation scale and avoids repeated computation of the expectation recurrence. This gives a meaningful asymptotic classification rather than a finite table or a routine numerical correction.
